title: Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage — Goodwill Windows and Share Limits
content:
# Goodwill Windows and Share Limits

For each coverage type of the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage, three figures define manufacturer goodwill after the coverage expires: the months after the expiration date within which the manufacturer considers a goodwill adjustment, the miles beyond the expiration odometer within which it considers one, and the largest share of a repair it pays as goodwill, expressed as a fraction.

| Coverage type | Window after the expiration date (months) | Window beyond the expiration odometer (miles) | Largest goodwill share of the repair |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty | 0 | 0 | 0.00 (0%) |
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | 0 | 0 | 0.00 (0%) |
| Factory Basic Limited Warranty | 12 | 12000 | 0.5 (50%) |
| Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty | 12 | 12000 | 0.5 (50%) |
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | 6 | 6000 | 0.5 (50%) |
| Federal Emissions Performance Warranty | 0 | 0 | 0.00 (0%) |
| Safety Recall Remedy Coverage | 0 | 0 | 0.00 (0%) |

## Reading the limits

- Three coverage types carry a goodwill share above 0.00: the Factory Basic Limited Warranty and the Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty (12 months and 12000 miles), and the Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty (6 months and 6000 miles), each at a share of at most 0.5.
- **Hypothetical figure.** On a repair priced at a hypothetical 800.00, a share of at most 0.5 caps a goodwill adjustment at 400.00.
